paper.title: EmbodiedSWE: Coding Agents for Long Horizon Dexterous Robotics
paper.claim_type_note: 论文同时含基准(evaluation_resource)与数据引擎/学生训练(component_training)；以首要研究问题和 contribution(1)为准选 evaluation_resource，但 E 项按作者的整体中心主张(含 Gen 与真机)评分，不缩窄主张。分类歧义留给聚合席。
paper.central_claim: We study coding agents for long-horizon, dexterous robotics and ask whether their solutions can provide scalable supervision for learning general robot policies. EmbodiedSWE-Bench shows frontier coding agents can solve complex long-horizon tasks and transfer prior solutions across tasks and embodiments; supporting tools help agents; EmbodiedSWE-Gen expands a single verified solution into large diverse trajectories, VLA performance improves with more generated demonstrations, agent-aided diversification improves generalization to held-out task variations, and a VLA finetuned solely on coding-agent-generated simulation demonstrations completes a long-horizon task on a real robot.
paper.scope_note: 在 docs/EVIDENCE.md 范围内(coding-agent harness + 教师→VLA 学生蒸馏 + 评测)

evidence.quote: Grading is performed entirely offline to prevent agents from modifying scene code or exploiting the reward mechanism.
evidence.support_explanation: 评分在独立离线环境中进行，降低 agent 篡改场景/奖励的空间。

evidence.quote: In others, a human-written rubric is used, combined with a VLM, to grade the trajectory or subcomponents of the trajectory.
evidence.support_explanation: 部分任务(形变类)的评分含 VLM 判分环节，属学习型/判官组件，文中未给出其校验。
六个模型的成功率与作弊率(每个 task-model 单次 4h 运行)。

evidence.quote: For each run, we use Opus 5 to audit whether it is a reward hack, and score it as 0 if it is.
evidence.support_explanation: 作弊判定由 Opus 5(同时是被评模型之一)审计，未报告人工校验或审计准确率。

evidence.quote: One 4-hour run per (task, model).
evidence.support_explanation: 每个 (task, model) 仅单次运行，无重复种子，仅有跨任务 SEM。

evidence.quote: Each run uses one NVIDIA RTX 4090 for simulation and a 4-hour wall-clock budget.
evidence.support_explanation: 预算设定。

evidence.quote: Each model uses its native coding harness: the first three use Claude Code, while the latter three use Codex.
evidence.support_explanation: 模型与 harness 完全共变(Claude 系列=Claude Code，GPT 系列=Codex)，模型比较不能分离 harness 效应。

evidence.quote: every evaluated task has been successfully completed at least once by a domain expert working with a coding model
evidence.support_explanation: 任务可行性由专家+编码模型验证过，支持任务有效性。

evidence.quote: Agents develop against a fixed seed but are explicitly informed that grading uses different initial conditions.
evidence.support_explanation: 开发种子与评分初始条件分开，是一层留出。

evidence.quote: We can see that both models are able to achieve better score with the tools, though effect sizes are relatively small.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者对工具效应的自述：均值分数略升、效应小。

evidence.quote: Each tool run uses two RTX 4090s rather than one
evidence.support_explanation: 工具运行额外 GPU，预算不对等(已披露)。

evidence.quote: Mean score 0.66 0.70 0.44 0.51 Success rate 50% 43% 18% 18%
evidence.support_explanation: 工具前后：Opus 5 均分 0.66→0.70 但成功率 50%→43%；Sol 均分 0.44→0.51，成功率不变。单次运行，无检验。

evidence.quote: As the no-hint reference, we reuse the Franka runs on these six tasks from the cross-task experiments.
evidence.support_explanation: 跨本体对照的无提示基线来自 Franka，而非 Kinova/xArm 的无提示运行，混杂了本体难度。

evidence.quote: Hints from similar tasks help the agent solve the target both better and faster; hints from dissimilar tasks speed up early progress but end at the same final score as the no-hint runs.
evidence.support_explanation: 跨任务提示：相似/不相似/无提示三臂对照，2 模型×3 种子，6 个目标任务。

evidence.quote: Generated trajectories are retained only if they pass the task grader and an open-loop replay check.
evidence.support_explanation: 数据保留规则：grader 通过 + 仅凭动作回放可复现成功。

evidence.quote: the mean success rate over the six tasks rises from 18% with 10 demonstrations to 69% with 400, and the mean rubric score from 0.32 to 0.76
evidence.support_explanation: VLA 数据规模曲线(6 任务均值)。

evidence.quote: using the same scene and initial-state distribution as the generated data
evidence.support_explanation: 规模曲线评测使用与训练数据同一场景/初态分布，属分布内。

evidence.locator: App E Relaxation of some evaluation criteria
evidence.quote: For some tasks, we relax the original success condition.
evidence.support_explanation: VLA 实验对部分任务放宽了成功判据。

evidence.quote: Clearing organic objects Complete the placement of one organic object. Pen holding Insert one pen into the holder. Banana slicing Cut the banana into at least three pieces.
evidence.support_explanation: 6 个头条任务中的 3 个(clear_organic_objects、pen_holder、slice)使用放宽判据。

evidence.quote: we train on 1000 generated trajectories, and evaluate on 256 out of distribution settings, reporting the average rubric score over evaluations.
evidence.support_explanation: 泛化对比的设置：等量 1000 条，256 个留出设置。

evidence.quote: VLA policies trained with agent-aided diversified data consistently achieve better performance on unseen scenarios than those trained with script-only data.
evidence.support_explanation: agent 辅助多样化 vs 纯脚本：留出变体上整体 rubric 0.233 vs 0.066(表1)。

evidence.quote: The script-only baseline remains concentrated around the original task distribution
evidence.support_explanation: 对照臂按设计只覆盖原分布(非等多样性的人/脚本场景扩展)，因此比较含有多样性混杂。

evidence.quote: they do not isolate the contribution of individual diversification levels
evidence.support_explanation: 作者承认未隔离五个多样化层级各自的贡献。

evidence.quote: report the fraction of trials that successfully complete all stages up to each milestone
evidence.support_explanation: 真机阶段成功率为累计到各里程碑的试验比例。

evidence.quote: Sim-trained 100% 80% 30% 20%
evidence.support_explanation: 真机 10 次试验：抓灯罩100%、放置80%、抓灯泡30%、旋出灯泡(全程)20%。

evidence.quote: We select the 14,000-step checkpoint based on real-robot performance.
evidence.support_explanation: 检查点按真机表现选取，选择与评测未见分离说明。

evidence.quote: We also show that a VLA finetuned solely on coding-agent-generated simulation demonstrations completes a long-horizon task on real robot.
evidence.support_explanation: 摘要主张'completes'；表2显示全程成功率20%。

evidence.quote: we have not yet run this pipeline end to end
evidence.support_explanation: 作者承认合成任务→解法→多样化→VLA 全流程未端到端跑通，蒸馏能力转移程度未知。

evidence.quote: Existing work remains largely constrained to navigation and pick-and-place tasks
evidence.support_explanation: 作者给出的 gap：既有 coding-agent 机器人工作局限于导航/抓放。

evidence.quote: while simulation benchmarks rarely combine long horizon tasks with challenging physical interactions
evidence.support_explanation: 作者给出的 gap：缺少长程+灵巧物理交互的仿真评测。

evidence.quote: i.e., the deployed policy itself, as opposed to a teacher.
evidence.support_explanation: 既有工作将代码视作终点策略，本文将其作为教师。

evidence.quote: Checkpoint tree. The agent saves reached simulator states together with the programs, logs, snapshots, and transition annotations
evidence.support_explanation: K204 对应的 harness 工具：检查点树(另有 CMA-ES、sweep、场景查看器、评估日志)。

evidence.quote: External restrictions interrupted the project before held-out evaluation could be conducted.
evidence.support_explanation: 编码 agent RL 无留出评测(作者承认)。

evidence.quote: We train Seed-2.1-Lite with turn-level PPO on 400 environments produced by the pipeline above.
evidence.support_explanation: 附录 G：在合成任务上做 turn-level PPO。

evidence.quote: learning tabula rasa with PPO still substantially underperforms the programmatic policies discovered by coding agents within the evaluated budgets
evidence.support_explanation: 编码 agent 程序策略 vs PPO 的主张；具体数值只在 Fig 5(无文本数值)。

evidence.quote: The tasks are drawn from the easier tiers of EmbodiedSWE-Bench
evidence.support_explanation: PPO 对照仅在 5 个较易任务，且作者称这些任务偏向 RL。

evidence.quote: Scorer hacking. Some agents attempt to improve the score without solving the task through the robot
evidence.support_explanation: 记录的三类失败之一：作弊。

evidence.locator: App D.2 Agent sessions and time limits
evidence.quote: A session runs one coding-agent process with a stage-specific brief
evidence.support_explanation: 多样化的核心操作由 agent 按'stage-specific brief'执行，brief 原文不在材料中。

evidence.quote: Total spend of solved runs ($) 1029 220 597 133 39 1591
evidence.support_explanation: 解决任务运行的 API 花费汇总(按模型)。

evidence.quote: on a subset of six tasks: clear_organic_objects , pen_holder , tool_packing , bulb , nut_thread , and slice
evidence.support_explanation: 正文称 6 个任务。

evidence.quote: coffee 3.10
evidence.support_explanation: 表21 实际包含 8 个任务(另含 coffee、pc_gpu)，与正文 6 任务头条均值不一致且未解释。

evidence.quote: the agent receives, in addition to the standard task materials, one read-only file containing either a verified solution to another task or a verified solution to the same task on a different embodiment
evidence.support_explanation: 经验提示机制：只读文件，非累积技能库。

evidence.quote: Each agent iteratively inspects the environment, executes candidate solutions, diagnoses failures, and revises its code, optimizing a program rather than the parameters of a learned policy.
evidence.support_explanation: solver 操作签名。

evidence.quote: to cover intermediate states that are rarely visited by end-to-end rollouts, the agent generates demonstrations that begin partway through a task.
evidence.support_explanation: 'phase' 层多样化：agent 构造中间状态起点。

evidence.quote: The agent adapts DART-style noise injection ( Laskey et al., 2017 ) to the task by inspecting a rendered rollout and writing phase-specific perturbations into the solution code
evidence.support_explanation: 'noise' 层：按阶段写入扰动并触发恢复分支。

evidence.support_explanation: 表7 称形变任务得分排除最终 VLM gate，但表6 标题未说明此处理，口径需核对。

evidence.support_explanation: 学生只见 RGB+本体状态，教师(编码 agent)见完整仿真状态。

evidence.support_explanation: 真机未微调基线 0%。
